sentences.text: Aggrieved by the fact that the claim petition filed by the petitioner before the first respondent under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 on 15.09.2023 and on 09.08.2024.

2.The petitioner's land measuring an extent of 1870 sq.mtrs. in S.No.758/2B1 and land measuring 50 sq.mtrs. in S.No.759/3, Moranapalli village, Hosur Taluk, Krishnagiri District was notified to be acquired for the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis purpose of laying National Highways 948A (Satellite Town Ring Road for Bangalore (West) extending to Hosur).

Despite objections submitted by the petitioner and claiming a market value of Rs.45,000/- per sq.mtrs. for the lands as it is situated within Housur Corporation and is located in an area where there are several Companies,
Hospitals and Import an Export Units etc.

3.However, the Special District Revenue Officer, the second respondent passed an award dated 27.07.2023 for compensation in respect of land measuring an extent of 1870 sq.mtrs in S.No.758/2B1 and land measuring 50 sq.mtr. in S.No.759/3 at Rs.267.35 per sq.mtr and the Authorities classified the land as dry Maanavari lands Type I.
Since the award is very meagre, the petitioner filed a claim petition before the first respondent, the Arbitrator cum District Collector under Section 3G(5) o the National Highways Act, 1956.
The first respondent has not taken up the said claim petition for enquiry.
The petitioner is before this Court.

4.Considering the limited prayer sought for by the petitioner and https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis taking into the fact that the first respondent is yet to act upon the petitioner claim, a mandamus is issued to the first respondent to consider and pass orders on the claim petition filed by the petitioner under Section 3G(5) o the National Highways Act, 1956 dated 15.09.2023 and 09.08.2024 within a period of 3 months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
